train_sdxl_dreambooth_lora: train an SDXL model with LoRA DreamBooth fine-tuning on Habana Gaudi HPU using a custom image dataset
run_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset to prepare instance and class images with prompts for SDXL LoRA fine-tuning
encode_prompt_sdxl: encode a text prompt into prompt embeddings and pooled embeddings using SDXL dual text encoders
parse_training_args: parse command-line arguments for SDXL LoRA DreamBooth training including optimizer, scheduler, and HPU config options
save_model_card_hf: generate and save a HuggingFace model card README with validation images and training metadata
